items.description: Cerro Verde is a major open-pit copper and molybdenum mining complex located near Arequipa. It is one of the largest mining operations in Peru, significantly contributing to the national economy.
The Cajamarquilla refinery, located near Lima, is a significant zinc smelting and refining facility in South America. It processes concentrates from various mines to produce high-purity zinc ingots.
The Bridge of Sighs is a historic wooden bridge located in the charming Barranco district of Lima. It is a well-known local landmark surrounded by traditional architecture and cultural history.
